title: Rewrite every entry
author: claude
summary: All earlier entries rewritten in plain English and sorted into topics, steps and sub-tasks.
what: We rewrote all 14 earlier entries and split the big ones, ending with 56 entries: 1 project root, 5 topics, 14 steps and 36 sub-tasks.
why: Part of making the dev log easier to read.
how: Jargon moved into tech cards and the collapsed settings. Existing images were moved to the entry they belong to, and `follows` and red strings were added where one thing really depended on another.
